Out-of-fold Ridge base predictions and a Ridge meta-model use the same nine operators, five folds, seeds and alpha grid as the matched AOM-Ridge control; the external test split remains untouched. This isolates a practical compact-bank ensemble but is not presented as a faithful reproduction of published SPRR or PROSAC.
